item.title: How WFH dads actually carve out time for a hobby
item.description:
This week's WFH Dads issue takes on the classic remote-parent dilemma: finding time for your own hobbies between work and family. The advice centers on practical guardrails — set clear limits on work hours, talk explicitly with your partner about carving out protected time, and be honest about seasons when it's okay to wait and pick a hobby back up later.

It's the issue's practical companion to its lighter recommendation of the week (a high-protein, low-calorie Fruity Pebbles breakfast). The core message: a hobby doesn't have to be daily or ambitious to count — the constraint is the schedule, so treat your free time like a calendar commitment, not leftover scraps.
